summary: Ligand Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K under Items 7.01 and 8.01 disclosing a press release announcing a financing agreement with private clinical-stage cell-therapy developer AvenCell Therapeutics for up to $47 million. Ligand committed up to $41 million across four tranches—first at closing, three tied to predetermined clinical milestones—in exchange for a mid-single-digit to low-double-digit royalty on worldwide net sales of all current and future AvenCell pipeline assets, including AVC-201 for relapsed/refractory AML and AVC-203 for B-cell malignancies. This is a routine royalty-financing transaction, not a special situation; no board recommendation, advisor, or change of control was disclosed.
